_readme: Schema and morning notes: src/content/SIMULATION.md. This file stays separate from edition.json. If storyId is not in today's edition, the block hides itself.
title: The earlier ask, set next to the one CNBC confirmed
intro: Switch between the fundraising target CNBC says OpenAI pared back and the ask CNBC confirmed on 31 October. The page does not subtract one from the other.
note: “Up to $30 billion” is the earlier target CNBC describes. “Up to $20 billion” is the ask CNBC confirmed on 31 October 2026. CNBC says the round is still in progress and has not closed, so both figures can change. The $10 billion reduction and the $1.25 trillion post-money valuation are what CNBC says the Financial Times reported. This briefing did not read the FT article. OpenAI did not immediately comment. None of these figures is cash received, and the page does not divide one by another.
